status_language.implemented: Connected source/resources/scenes, statically inspected; no runtime claim.
status_language.verification_pending: Needs explicit permission and actual runtime/render/profiler evidence.

verification: Source/resource/reference/diff inspection only. No Godot imports, game launches, automated tests or runtime tests executed.

findings.finding: Death-menu scene reload recreated class defaults and destroyed recovery state.
findings.change: GameSession owns CharacterState; last-shrine respawn restores character records, validates landing and refills resources without resetting currency/equipment.
findings.unverified: Respawn/reload/failure paths and cross-scene restoration.

findings.finding: Player death deleted unrelated currency pickups and did not replace recovery on zero-currency death.
findings.change: Player recovery has separate ownership; zero-currency death clears only prior recovery. Enemy/world rewards have independent persistent records.
findings.unverified: Two deaths, zero-Embers replacement, collection/save ordering.

findings.finding: Dead-player interaction could recover currency.
findings.change: Shared can_world_interact gate rejects dead/unready/paused/committed-action/transformed actors; shrine, currency and authored rewards enforce it even through direct interact calls.
findings.unverified: Direct and input-driven interactions during death/restore.

findings.finding: Invalid typed light fields and copied Sentinel charged configurations.
findings.change: Repaired typed nulls and eight copied charged action resources individually. Added explicit sword damage to preserve existing behavior when new DamageProfiles default to zero.
findings.unverified: Parsing and actual weapon feel/balance. Existing light values are inventoried, not fully rebalanced.

findings.finding: Utility restoration ignored use time.
findings.change: USING_UTILITY commits charge, releases restoration/VFX/audio at use_time, then recovery. Stagger/death cancels unreleased restoration without refund.
findings.unverified: Movement, interruption boundaries and visual ownership.

findings.finding: Receiver acceptance was inferred inconsistently and effect-only contacts bypassed protection.
findings.change: HitRequest/HitResult now connects receiver eligibility, damage and actor-owned status application, with explicit rejected/effect-only outcomes; accepted proc children bypass only their own fresh protection timer.
findings.unverified: Parser/runtime correctness and rendered quality have not been verified.

findings.finding: Melee did not consistently check intervening geometry.
findings.change: Player and Sentinel contacts use elevation-aware obstruction query before receiver application; artwork never supplies reach.
findings.unverified: Corners, walls, floors and both hands.

findings.finding: Spell memory counted entries and re-preparation could reset remaining uses.
findings.change: Summed memory cost at class/application/menu/save boundaries; retained finite-use pool across preparation and saves.
findings.unverified: Unequal memory costs, empty slots, remove/re-add and reload.

findings.finding: Enemy name-only variants and permanent damage provocation lack planned pursuit/search behavior.
findings.unverified: Parser/runtime correctness and rendered quality have not been verified.
findings.change: Distinct grave/greywatch/stalker/cantor definitions and scenes share EnemyMind perception, local alerts, last-known search/return, authored moves and bounded windup tracking.

findings.finding: Global scans, path requests and navigation invalidation may cause avoidable work.
findings.change: ActorRegistry spatial queries, bounded floor-aware elevation bookkeeping, route/stair graph, eight floor/clearance grid windows with 256-probe scheduling and a configurable 128-chunk cosmetic terrain cache are connected.
findings.unverified: Source risk reductions only; cold-load, fullscreen, memory growth, stair reachability and 60 FPS require profiling.

findings.finding: No persistent session/settings, ownership or acquisition.
findings.change: Session/backup/settings/ownership now includes authored acquisition, levels/free earned-point respec/upgrades/materials, owned-loadout search, utilities, development catalogue isolation and magic-ready starter.
findings.unverified: Parser/runtime correctness and rendered quality have not been verified.

findings.finding: Raven entry was possible during combat.
findings.change: Entry uses existing player combat predicate; combat does not force airborne reversion; landing/collision rules preserved.
findings.unverified: Combat transitions, safe reversion, death/rest/reload.

findings.finding: Catalyst-provided unlimited basics and status buildup framework are not present.
findings.change: Catalyst-owned unlimited virtual basics share the existing delivery system. Poison, bleed and frost implement buildup/resistance/decay/cleansing/icon feedback; existing finite spells and Blackflame are retained.
findings.unverified: Parser/runtime correctness and rendered quality have not been verified.

findings.finding: UI modal ownership, persistent settings and controller map parity are incomplete.
findings.change: Shared editable theme/settings scene, title/slots, controller floor-aware map, bindings/device prompts/UI scale, responsive scrollable owned-loadout/services and modal pause ownership are connected.
findings.unverified: Parser/runtime correctness and rendered quality have not been verified.

findings.finding: Acceptance source described obsolete courtyard behavior.
findings.change: Obsolete acceptance script replaced with opt-in current data/contract checks; disposable current-scale combat lab and full manual matrix authored. NO tests/imports executed.
findings.unverified: All authored checks and gameplay/manual/visual/performance acceptance remain unrun. Data checks are not full gameplay automation.

findings.finding: CI engine did not match the reported editor.
findings.change: Pinned existing CI download/import configuration to Godot 4.7.1. Workflow not dispatched.
findings.unverified: Download/export/import success.

findings.finding: Audit warned newer work was untracked.
findings.change: Starting inspection found a clean 610-file baseline already committed at d151e70. No new snapshot commit was needed or created.

findings.unverified: Parser/runtime correctness and rendered quality have not been verified.

findings.finding: Procedural audio/music expansion.
findings.change: Inspector procedural sound/music definitions, cached synthesis, 18 prioritized effect voices and six music voices, exploration/combat blend, surface/context audio, floor attenuation and persisted volume.
findings.unverified: Parser/runtime correctness and rendered quality have not been verified.

findings.finding: World/interiors/navigation/climate integration.
findings.change: Existing geography and manual transforms retained with illustrated presentation, discoveries, floor-aware coarse/local navigation and bounded cosmetic cache; pausable 24-minute day/clear/overcast/rain/interior shelter.

findings.finding: Checkpoints, map floors, controller map and fast travel.
findings.change: Four total checkpoint shrines, attunement and saved validated travel; controller map, floor selection/placement, persistence, arrival fades and beacons connected.
findings.unverified: Parser/runtime correctness and rendered quality have not been verified.

findings.finding: Maintained authoring validation and tooling.
findings.change: Editor resource/stable-ID audit, asset shelf with UndoRedo scene placement, collision/landing/encounter/spell/navigation-floor overlays, disposable combat lab, full tuning/architecture/migration guides.
findings.unverified: Parser/runtime correctness and rendered quality have not been verified.

findings.finding: Unequipping a utility could refill it on re-preparation.
findings.change: Owned utility pool persists separately; prepared counts seed old schema1 records; shrine rest refills all owned utilities.
findings.unverified: Equip/remove/reload/rest charge sequences.

findings.finding: A validation scene must not overwrite real character slots.
findings.change: Development sandbox temporarily preserves active character, disables slot writes, grants disposable catalogue and restores on scene exit; load/create guarded until leaving.
findings.unverified: F6 lab/respawn/title/close/load ordering.

findings.finding: Malformed timed-effect intervals could reach a non-terminating tick loop outside the normal spell validation path.
findings.change: SpellEffectDefinition validates positive finite intervals/duration/restoration. Delivery, authoring audit and actor application use the same guard; malformed hot-edited entries are removed.
findings.unverified: Runtime invalid-resource rejection and periodic scheduling. Opt-in regression source authored only.

findings.finding: New perception could reacquire targets while an enemy was dead, and legacy reset cleanup did not clear EnemyMind.
findings.change: Dead actors no longer update perception. Death/reset clears shared pursuit/search/cooldowns. Shrine restoration also clears standalone status buildup components.
findings.unverified: Death near encounters, rest/reset after pursuit, corpse alert suppression.

findings.finding: Duplicate pause settings could drift from the shared settings panel; nested settings needed focus/ownership restoration.
findings.change: Pause uses only the shared settings panel. Title settings owns its modal and restores focus; gameplay settings returns to its still-paused parent menu.
findings.unverified: Controller/keyboard cancel and settings focus across title/pause/scene exit.
